author: Carol and Kent (nomad_kiwis)
citation: the first night we didn't find it and ended up sleeping on a beach on the way and finding the gathering the next day. We have now been camping there since the 1st of November, on a beach north of La Paz
location: Beach north of La Paz, Baja California, Mexico
provenance: Travel journal entry by New Zealand travelers Carol and Kent on WorldNomads, November 2008, recounting sleeping on a beach while searching for a Rainbow gathering and subsequently camping on the sand.
